findings.note: An Aug 19, 2026 Rotowire item says new head coach Mike McCarthy rested Rodgers for a preseason game, so Rodgers is still the Steelers QB. No report from this week on his injury status or whether he will start was found.

In the Dec 28, 2025 game against Cleveland, Rodgers had one rush for six yards. That shows he can clear 0.5 yards, but it was a single carry, so one kneel-down or zero scrambles would make the over lose.

Late in 2025, Rodgers, then 41, played with a cast on a fractured left wrist, took several big hits and briefly left a game. This points to limited mobility and a past of missing time, which hurts a rushing-yards over. This is old reporting, not news from this week.

Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and will play after missing three games with a high ankle sprain. That helps scoring, but he says the pain is only 'bearable,' so his mobility may still be limited, which works against the Over.

Baltimore went 1-2 without Jackson and failed to score in the second half of its last two games. Buffalo WR DJ Moore and TE Kincaid are questionable, and Ravens defenders Roquan Smith and Kyle Hamilton will play.

The final Week 8 report lists Ravens S Jaylinn Hawkins and G Ioane as out. For Buffalo, WR Shavers is out, and WR Moore, TE Kincaid, OT Spencer Brown and CB Alford are questionable, so pass-catcher depth on both sides is in doubt.

ESPN's Matt Bowen picks Flournoy as a fantasy pickup against Arizona, not as a receptions prop bet. He says Flournoy has three straight double-digit fantasy games and is Prescott's No. 3 option behind Lamb and Pickens, giving him a stable floor.

ESPN lists Flournoy as Active with 23 catches for 234 yards and 1 TD in the 2026 regular season. The number of games isn't shown, so his per-game catch rate compared with the 3.5 line can't be confirmed here.
NFL.com lists Flournoy as active. In last season's Week 9 game against the Cardinals he caught 2 passes for 12 yards and a TD, below this line. That was a 2025 game with a different role.
Steichen confirmed Jones will start (Oct 26), but RotoWire warns that more poor games could lead the 2-5 Colts to try Anthony Richardson, so a mid-game benching could cut Jones's attempts.
Jones's recent attempts were 22 (last week's 16-10 loss to MIN), 42, 44, 34 and 36, so his last game fell well short of 31.5; Jacksonville's defense ranks 3rd in points allowed (17.3).
Covers picks Jaguars -9.5 (total 46.5) and expects a comfortable JAX win, which points to the Colts trailing and passing more, though it rates Jones's efficiency among the league's worst.
